about.overview: Rosie Greene has been a practitioner of Visceral Manipulation since 2008, with this work becoming the foundation for all of her treatments. She runs an extensive clinical practice in North Canterbury, New Zealand treating adults and children, who present with a broad spectrum of clinical presentations ranging from the elite athletes, to people with gastro-intestinal and pelvic conditions, post-surgical and post trauma conditions, and many others. Rosie’s broad post graduate training includes studies in visceral, vascular and neural manipulation and craniosacral therapy.
